name: Gadarenes
overview: The account of the Gadarenes, also called the Gergesenes, reveals Jesus' authority over demonic forces as He encounters two violent, demon-possessed men living among the tombs. The demons recognize Jesus as the Son of God and fear His coming judgment, pleading to enter a nearby herd of swine, which subsequently rushes into the sea and perishes. Despite this miraculous deliverance, the herdsmen flee to the city to report the event, illustrating both the power of Christ to save and the mixed response of rejection from those He came to redeem.
